newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Blue chip gains push Slovak SAX index higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue chip gains push Slovak SAX index higher.

text.p: Slovak blue chips closed mostly higher in thinner trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, boosting the 16-share SAX index 0.27 points to 194.47.
Oil refiner Slovnaft edged up three crowns to 1,015, while VSZ steel closed unchanged at 740.
Brokers, however, said a significant lack of liquidity continues to hamper the bourse, with little change in its fortunes seen in the coming weeks.
"Slovnaft is slowly, but constantly rising," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said. "I think if its price rises a bit further, its liquidity may also increase dramatically."
Overall volume rose to 351,989 shares, from 195,115 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover increased to 116.27 million crowns, from 111.02 million.
